props.text: OUT can be written only in MAN. SP is locked in CAS (it comes from the primary loop).

config.expression: if({view.custom.isEngineer}, "Changes are written to the PLC when you press Apply.", "Read only. Log in with the " + {view.custom.engineerRole} + " role to change tuning.")

config.script:
if self.view.custom.isEngineer:
		base = self.view.params.tagPath
		names = ['Kp', 'Ti', 'Td', 'Action', 'SP_Lo', 'SP_Hi', 'OUT_Lo', 'OUT_Hi', 'AlmHi', 'AlmLo', 'AlmDev']
		edit = self.view.custom.edit
		system.tag.writeBlocking([base + "/" + n for n in names], [edit[n] for n in names])
	system.perspective.closePopup("")

base = self.view.params.tagPath
	names = ['Kp', 'Ti', 'Td', 'Action', 'SP_Lo', 'SP_Hi', 'OUT_Lo', 'OUT_Hi', 'AlmHi', 'AlmLo', 'AlmDev']
	vals = system.tag.readBlocking([base + "/" + n for n in names])
	edit = {}
	for n, q in zip(names, vals):
		edit[n] = q.value
	self.view.custom.edit = edit
